metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Verdant Tickets (event ticketing); Platform: AWS us-east-2, Kubernetes cluster vt-prod-use2 (EKS, node range 10.66.0.0/16); Payments: card authorisations are sent by payment-svc to an external payment provider API, protected by a circuit breaker; external synthetic probes monitor public dependencies; Change management: CHG- identifiers.
investigation_questions: What external IP address did the failing endpoint resolve to?
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Was the failure caused by an internal change? Answer yes or no.
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which alert fired earliest in the query window but is unrelated to the incident?
Which change restored normal service? Provide its change identifier.
